name: Aetherfall Battlegrounds
desc:
Choose from a variety of weapons to fight random opponents! 
This game is NOT a reference to any anime, it is original

Controls: 
T = Transform/Fly,
Left Shift = Lock Cursor,  
F = Block, 
Q = Dash, 
G = Ultimate,  
S = Ragdoll Recovery (Hold it while in ragdoll)
Jump + Hold Space = Air Walk
Air Walk + Q = Double Jump

General Information:
Blue Bar = Ragdoll Cancel,
White Bar = Dash Cooldown,
Green Bar = Health,

PC IS HEAVILY RECOMMENDED

Join the group for future projects!
